steps.title: Title and summary
points: Use a plain title: Admin Intern
Add the team, location and dates
Sum up the role in two sentences
steps.tip: Plain titles get found. Students search for admin intern, not office hero.

steps.title: Day-to-day tasks
points: Manage inboxes and the team diary
Set up meetings and take notes
Keep records and files up to date
Order supplies and handle the post
steps.tip: List 4 to 6 real tasks so applicants can picture the job.

steps.title: Skills you need
points: Organised, with an eye for detail
steps.tip: Keep must-haves short. Most admin skills are learned on the job.

steps.title: What they'll learn
steps.tip: Students choose internships for what they learn. Say it clearly.

steps.title: How to apply
points: What to send: CV and a short note
steps.tip: Reply to every applicant, even with a quick no.
